title: On the small side.
text: On the small side.. Disappointed it is really small for our cuisinart oven. Good quality, fine product just seems way too small for our toaster oven.

product_metadata.title: Range Kleen Non Stick Toaster Oven Cookie Sheet 8 Inches by 10 Inches
features: A BAKING ESSENTIAL: The Range Kleen B24TC Non Stick Toaster Oven Cookie Sheet is designed for toaster oven cooking and can be used in smaller ovens. Bake a small batch of cookies, some potatoes and vegetables with this fundamental bakeware
FINE CRAFTED BAKEWARE: With outer dimensions of 8 inches by 10 inches, the premium non-stick coating prevents food from sticking
WORRY-FREE COOKING: Oven safe to 350 degrees F. The Range Kleen B24TC fits most toaster ovens and is ideal for cooking smaller portions of food
COOK AND CLEAN AWAY: Perfect for cooking 1 to 2 servings of food, the non-stick material makes it easy to hand wash and clean for next use anytime
COMPATIBLE TO MOST COOKWARE: It is compatible with most range toaster ovens and nests with complimentary crisper pan and roaster pan (sold separately)
description: Cook and Enjoy smaller serving of food with the Range Kleen B24TC Non Stick Toaster Oven Cookie Sheet. At 8 inches by 10 inches in size, this is designed for toaster oven cooking and can be used in smaller ovens. Oven safe to 350 degrees F, bake a small batch of cookies, couple of potatoes or roast a few vegetables. The premium non-stick coating prevents food from sticking.
